title: Was steht da?
description: Help someone who does not read German. Pass on the times and places from a sign, a notice, a timetable or an announcement in simple English, and pass on a simple English message about times and places in simple German.

exercises.instruction_en: Warm up. Match the sentences from the Bürgeramt with their English meaning.

pairs.right: What do I have to bring?
Do you have your documents with you?

pairs.left: Gehen Sie bitte zum Schalter zwei!

exercises.instruction_en: Warm up. Fill in the station word. The hint gives the English word.

payload.text: Die ___ in Bonn ist um 9:15 Uhr. Die ___ in Köln ist um 9:45 Uhr. Der Zug fährt von ___ 3 ab.

exercises.instruction_en: Your friend Sam wants to register but cannot read German. You both stand in front of this notice on the door. Read it and choose what you tell Sam.

payload.title: Schild an der Tür
payload.text:
Achtung!
Das Bürgeramt ist am Montag geschlossen.
Am Dienstag ist das Amt von 8 bis 16 Uhr geöffnet.
Auskunft: Rathaus, Zimmer 3

questions.question: Sam asks: Can I register today? Today is Monday.
options: No, the office is closed on Monday.

questions.question: Sam asks: When can I come back?
Sam asks: Where can I ask a question?
questions.explanation_en: Die Auskunft is the place where you get information.

exercises.instruction_en: You and Sam wait for the train to Berlin. There is an announcement, in German eine Durchsage. Listen, then choose what you tell Sam.

payload.transcript: Achtung, eine Durchsage. Der Zug nach Berlin fährt heute von Gleis zwei ab. Abfahrt um sechzehn Uhr dreißig. Ich wiederhole: Gleis zwei, sechzehn Uhr dreißig.

questions.question: Sam asks: What did they say? Choose the right summary.
options: The train from Berlin arrives at platform 2 at 16:30.
The train to Berlin leaves from platform 16 at 2:30.
The train to Berlin leaves from platform 2 at 16:30.

questions.question: Sam asks: So what time is that on my watch?
options: half past four in the afternoon
half past six in the evening
half past two in the afternoon
questions.explanation_en: Sechzehn Uhr dreißig is 16:30, so half past four in the afternoon.

exercises.instruction_en: Say the meaning to yourself, then turn the card and rate how well you knew it.

payload.hint: mit takes the dative: mit dem Bus, mit dem Zug, mit der Bahn. About a friend you say: Sam fährt mit dem Bus.

exercises.instruction_en: Match the words from signs and notices with their English meaning. Der Plan is a map or a timetable: der Stadtplan, der Fahrplan.
Sam has a cold and wants to go to the pharmacy. Read the sign on the door and choose what you tell Sam.

payload.question: Apotheke am Park: heute geschlossen. Die nächste Apotheke ist am Bahnhof.
options: This pharmacy is open today until the evening.
This pharmacy has moved to the park.
This pharmacy is closed today. The nearest one is at the station.
payload.explanation_en: You do not translate word for word. You pass on what matters to Sam: closed today, and where to go.

exercises.instruction_en: Sam cannot read this notice. Tell Sam in simple English what it says.

payload.source_text: Das Bürgeramt ist am Freitag von 8 bis 12 Uhr geöffnet.
reference: The Bürgeramt is open on Friday from 8 to 12.
The registration office is open on Friday from 8 to 12.
On Friday the office is open from 8 am to 12 noon.
payload.notes_en: The day and the two times are what Sam needs. You may keep the German name Bürgeramt.

exercises.instruction_en: Sam asks when and where the train to Cologne leaves. You read this line on the board. Tell Sam in simple English.

payload.source_text: Der Zug nach Köln fährt um 9:15 Uhr von Gleis 3 ab.
reference: The train to Cologne leaves at 9:15 from platform 3.
The train to Köln leaves from platform 3 at 9:15.
The Cologne train departs at 9:15 from platform 3.
payload.notes_en: Place, time and platform must all be right.

exercises.instruction_en: You and Sam want to take the bus. This notice hangs at the stop. Tell Sam in simple English what it says.

payload.source_text: Achtung! Die Haltestelle Rathaus ist heute geschlossen. Der Bus hält am Bahnhof.
reference: Attention! The Rathaus stop is closed today. The bus stops at the station.
The town hall stop is closed today. The bus stops at the station.
This stop is closed today. The bus leaves from the station.
payload.notes_en: Sam needs two things: this stop is closed today, and the bus stops at the station.

exercises.instruction_en: Put the words in the right order to say where the bus stops today. Start with Der Bus.

payload.answer: Der Bus hält heute am Bahnhof.

exercises.instruction_en: Now the other way round. Sam sends you this in English. Your neighbour Frau Becker speaks only German and wants to meet Sam. Tell her in German.

payload.source_text: Sam arrives at the station at 6 pm.
reference: Sam kommt um 18 Uhr am Bahnhof an.
Sam kommt um achtzehn Uhr am Bahnhof an.
Sam kommt um sechs Uhr am Bahnhof an.
Sam ist um 18 Uhr am Bahnhof.
payload.notes_en: ankommen is separable, so an goes to the end. At the station is am Bahnhof.

exercises.instruction_en: Record yourself. Pass on a message in simple German. Take a minute to prepare first.

payload.prompt_en: Sam writes to you in English: My train arrives in Cologne today at 14:20, platform 5. Then I go by bus 12 to the Rathaus stop. Your neighbour Frau Becker speaks only German and asks: Wann kommt Sam an? Tell her in two or three short German sentences when and where Sam arrives and which bus Sam takes.
payload.sample_answer: Sam kommt heute um 14:20 Uhr in Köln an, auf Gleis 5. Dann fährt Sam mit dem Bus 12 zur Haltestelle Rathaus.
rubric_focus: the time, the platform and the bus number are passed on correctly
the place: Köln and Haltestelle Rathaus
ankommen with an at the end
short, simple sentences that a patient listener can follow
